prompt: Write the body (about 250 words) of a Texas personal injury petition by a car accident victim against an auto insurer, with the parts Parties, Facts, Negligence and Damages in plain text. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [PLAINTIFF_NAME], [LOSS_DATE], [CITY] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1434; do not mention it.)
text:
PARTIES

Plaintiff [PLAINTIFF_NAME] is an individual residing in Texas who was operating a passenger vehicle at the time of the collision described below. Defendant is the automobile liability insurer that issued the policy under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this petition is brought. Defendant may be served through its registered agent for service of process in the State of Texas.

FACTS

On [LOSS_DATE], Plaintiff was driving through a signalized intersection in [CITY] when another motorist entered the intersection and struck the driver's side of Plaintiff's vehicle in a side-impact collision. The force of the impact pushed Plaintiff's vehicle sideways and caused the airbags to deploy. Plaintiff reported the collision promptly, provided the required information, and submitted a claim under the applicable coverage. Defendant has not paid the claim in an amount sufficient to cover Plaintiff's losses, and Plaintiff has been forced to pursue this action.

NEGLIGENCE

The at-fault motorist failed to yield the right of way and failed to keep a proper lookout before entering the intersection. Defendant, as the insurer responsible for the coverage at issue, failed to investigate the claim in a reasonable and prompt manner, failed to communicate a reasonable explanation for its position, and failed to pay benefits owed under the policy once liability became reasonably clear. These acts and omissions violate the Texas Insurance Code and constitute a breach of the insurance contract and of the duty of good faith and fair dealing.

DAMAGES

As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a serious injury to the shoulder that required medical evaluation and ongoing treatment. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and diminished capacity to work and perform daily activities, and will likely continue to experience pain and limitation in the future. Plaintiff seeks recovery of policy benefits, statutory damages, interest, court costs, and attorney's fees, and requests judgment in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT].
